title: Flownomaly: Single-Step Conditional-Mean Recovery for Few-Shot Anomaly Detection
abstract: arXiv:2610.32964v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Few-shot industrial anomaly detection requires modeling category-specific normality from only a handful of defect-free images. Common approaches tie inference to stored exemplars, impose rigid linear structure, or risk reproducing anomalous content. Flownomaly instead casts the problem as normal-counterpart recovery in frozen DINOv2 feature space. Given normal supports, a velocity field is learned through conditional flow matching over frozen patch tokens to transport Gaussian noise toward normal features. Along straight paths, a single recovery step using one evaluation of the optimal field yields the posterior mean of the clean normal token without trajectory integration. The operating time governs how strongly recovery modifies a query token. translated_title: Flownomaly：面向小样本异常检测的单步条件均值恢复
translated_abstract: 小样本工业异常检测需要仅从少量无缺陷图像中建模类别特定的正常性。常见方法要么将推理与存储的示例绑定，要么施加刚性的线性结构，要么存在重现异常内容的风险。Flownomaly则将该问题转化为在冻结的DINOv2特征空间中进行正常对应物的恢复。给定正常支持样本，通过对冻结的patch token进行条件流匹配来学习一个速度场，将高斯噪声传输至正常特征。沿直线路径，仅需对最优场进行一次评估的单个恢复步骤，即可得到干净正常token的后验均值，无需轨迹积分。运行时间决定了恢复对查询token的修改强度。在没有异常验证样本可用于调参的情况下，一种仅依赖正常样本的Jacobian增益-噪声准则即可仅从支持样本中选出该时间。查询token与……
tldr: Flownomaly将小样本工业异常检测建模为冻结DINOv2特征空间中的“正常对应物恢复”问题，通过条件流匹配学习速度场，仅需单步评估即可恢复干净正常特征的后验均值，并利用仅基于正常样本的Jacobian增益-噪声准则自动确定运行时间，无需异常验证样本。
en_tdlr: Flownomaly reframes few-shot anomaly detection as normal-counterpart recovery in frozen DINOv2 feature space, using conditional flow matching to learn a velocity field that recovers the posterior mean of clean normal tokens in a single step, with the operating time automatically selected by a normal-only Jacobian gain-to-noise criterion requiring no anomalous validation samples.
